readme:
# BrannHost — Lightweight Ubuntu SSH for Railway

![BrannHost](https://img101.pixhost.cc/images/77/546441106_skyzopedia.jpg)

Minimal Ubuntu 24.04 SSH server with **Node.js 22** + **PM2** ready.

## Deploy Steps
1. Set **ROOT_PASSWORD** (required) in Variables
2. Add **TCP Proxy** on port `22` (Settings → Networking)
3. Redeploy, then connect:

```bash
ssh root@<your-railway-domain> -p <port>
```

## Variables
- `ROOT_PASSWORD` (**required**) — root password
- `HOSTNAME` (optional) — custom hostname
- `SSH_USERNAME` + `SSH_PASSWORD` (optional) — secondary sudo user
- `AUTHORIZED_KEYS` (optional) — SSH public keys for root

## Included
- Node.js 22.x + npm
- PM2 (global)
- neofetch, git, htop, tmux, vim, nano

Telegram: t.me/brannaichannel · t.me/brannaichannel

© BrannHost

ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Mandatory root password. Container will refuse to start without it. Change after first login.

HOSTNAME.description: Optional custom hostname for the container.

SSH_USERNAME.description: Optional secondary user. Must be set together with SSH_PASSWORD.

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password for the optional secondary user. Set together with SSH_USERNAME.

AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: SSH public key(s) for root key-based authentication. Password login stays enabled.
